description: LinearResampler vectors. Output sample n reads input position p = n*from/to (i = floor(p), r = n*from mod to) and is floor((2*(s[i]*(to-r) + s[i+1]*r) + to) / (2*to)), all in integer arithmetic. Streaming push() emits while s[i+1] is available; flush() emits the rest holding the last sample. `chunks` gives split points for the streaming check, whose concatenated output must equal `output`.
